overview: This specification defines the complete application state architecture for FSHQ.gg, covering user context states (roles, permissions, preferences), business process state machines (league connection, team claiming, content publishing), component UI states (loading, error handling, data synchronization), and global application states (connectivity, caching, authentication). The architecture supports a multi-role fantasy sports clubhouse platform where commissioners create weekly content, members engage through pick'ems competitions, and automated sync processes maintain data consistency with external platforms. State management follows React patterns with server state via React Query, local component state via hooks, and persistent preferences via database. All state transitions include validation rules, error recovery procedures, and rollback strategies to ensure data integrity and positive user experience.

UserRole.description: User's role within a specific league context determines permissions and UI access
recovery_procedures: If role change fails mid-transaction, rollback to previous role
If last admin is demoted, prevent transaction and show error
If membership approval fails, preserve pending state for retry

UserPermissions.description: Granular permissions derived from user role that control feature access
recovery_procedures: If permission check fails, default to most restrictive (guest) permissions
Cache permissions per session, invalidate on role change
Refresh permissions on page reload if stale

UserPreferences.description: User-configurable preferences for notifications, display, and behavior
recovery_procedures: If preferences save fails, keep in-memory state and retry on next update
If preferences corrupted, reset to defaults with user notification

OnboardingProgress.description: Tracks new user onboarding flow completion status
OnboardingProgress.persistence: database: users.preferences.onboarding_status or separate onboarding_progress table
recovery_procedures: If onboarding interrupted, resume from last completed step
Allow manual restart of onboarding from user settings
Skip onboarding for users with existing league memberships

ActiveLeagueContext.description: Currently selected league for multi-league users
recovery_procedures: If league context lost, redirect to league selector
If league no longer accessible, show error and redirect to accessible league
Default to most recently active league on login

states.name: validating
states.description: Validating Sleeper league ID or username

states.name: confirming
states.description: Showing league details for user confirmation

states.name: validation_failed
states.description: League ID invalid or not found

validation_rules: League ID must be valid Sleeper format (numeric)
League must not already be connected to FSHQ
User must be authenticated
Sleeper API must be reachable
League must have at least 2 teams

error_states.name: validation_failed
error_states.recovery: User can retry with different league ID or username
error_states.user_message: We couldn't find that league. Please check your league ID or username and try again.

error_states.name: already_connected
error_states.recovery: User can join existing league or go back
error_states.user_message: This league is already connected to FSHQ. Would you like to join it?

error_states.name: sync_error
error_states.recovery: Automatic retry with exponential backoff, or manual retry by user
error_states.user_message: We encountered an error syncing your league data. We'll retry automatically, or you can try again manually.

rollback_procedures: If sync fails after league record created, mark as connection_failed but preserve record
If sync partially completes, preserve fetched data for differential retry
If user cancels during sync, stop sync job but keep partial data
Allow admin to manually retry sync or delete failed connection
success_criteria: All teams imported with Sleeper roster IDs
Unique URL slug generated and assigned

states.name: unclaimed
states.description: User has not claimed a team yet

states.name: claiming
states.description: Validating team claim against Sleeper user ID

states.name: claimed
states.description: Team successfully claimed and linked to user

validation_rules: User must match Sleeper username or user_id for selected team
Team cannot be claimed by multiple users unless co-manager is explicitly supported
User must have manager role to claim teams
Claim can be released within 24-hour grace period or by admin

error_states.name: claim_rejected
error_states.recovery: User can try different team or contact admin
error_states.user_message: We couldn't verify you as the owner of this team. Please try another team or contact a league admin.

error_states.name: pending_admin_approval
error_states.user_message: Your team claim requires admin approval. We've notified the league admin to review your request.

rollback_procedures: If claim fails mid-transaction, no database changes persist
If user releases claim within grace period, team becomes available again
If admin overrides claim, original user notified and team reassigned
success_criteria: User granted manager role and permissions
Team visible in user's league context

validation_rules: Only admins can approve/reject memberships
Membership must be in pending status to approve/reject
League join_rule must be 'approval_required' for workflow to apply

error_states.name: approval_failed
error_states.recovery: Preserve pending state, admin can retry
error_states.user_message: Approval failed. Please try again.

rollback_procedures: If approval fails, membership remains pending
If notification fails, user is approved but email queued for retry
success_criteria: User granted appropriate access if approved

states.name: empty
states.description: No content created for this week yet

states.name: published
states.description: Content live and visible to league

states.name: editing_published
states.description: Creating updated version of published content

states.name: skipped
states.description: Commissioner chose to skip this week

validation_rules: Power rankings must have all teams ranked with no duplicates
Matchup predictions must reference valid matchup IDs
Featured matchup must be one of the predicted matchups
Commentary fields have max length of 500 characters
Cannot publish if required sections are incomplete unless explicitly skipped

error_states.name: publish_failed
error_states.recovery: Preserve draft, allow user to fix and retry
error_states.user_message: Publishing failed. Your draft has been saved. Please try again.

error_states.name: autosave_failed
error_states.recovery: Queue changes in local storage, retry when connection restored
error_states.user_message: Autosave failed. Your changes are saved locally and will sync when connection is restored.

rollback_procedures: If publish fails, rollback all database changes and preserve draft
If moment creation fails, rollback content publish status
If republish fails, preserve original published version
Autosave failures queue changes for retry on next interval
success_criteria: Content status updated to published in database
Feed moments created for each published section
Power rankings page updated with new data
League members notified or can see new content in feed

states.name: not_submitted
states.description: User has not submitted picks for this week

states.name: submitted_unlocked
states.description: Picks submitted but matchups not locked yet (editable)

validation_rules: User can only pick teams that are in the matchup
Picks cannot be edited after lock time
Partial submissions are allowed (not all matchups must be picked)
Lock time is per-matchup based on game start time
Grading only occurs after stat correction window (72 hours)

error_states.name: submission_failed
error_states.recovery: Preserve picks in local storage, retry submission
error_states.user_message: Pick submission failed. Your picks are saved locally. Please try again.

error_states.name: grading_error
error_states.recovery: Queue for manual grading or retry on next grading cycle
error_states.user_message: Grading is delayed. We'll update your results shortly.

rollback_procedures: If submission fails, picks remain in local state for retry
If grading fails, preserve ungraded state and retry on next cycle
If re-grading fails due to stat correction, preserve original grade until corrected
success_criteria: Picks saved in database with timestamp
Grades calculated correctly after matchup completion
Stat corrections trigger re-grading within 4 hours

MatchupCompletionCorrections.process_name: Matchup Finalization and Stat Correction Handling

states.name: completed_provisional
states.description: Matchup finished but within stat correction window

states.name: finalized
states.description: Stat correction window passed, result final

validation_rules: Matchups monitored for 72 hours after completion for stat corrections
Score changes >0.1 points trigger correction detection
Winner changes trigger immediate re-grading of affected picks
Correction moments generated only for winner-changing corrections

error_states.name: sync_failure_during_correction_window
error_states.recovery: Continue monitoring, retry sync on next interval
error_states.user_message: Score updates delayed. Refreshing...

rollback_procedures: If correction detection fails, queue for manual review
If re-grading fails, preserve original grades and retry
If correction moment creation fails, log error and create on next sync
success_criteria: Stat corrections detected and processed within 4 hours
Correction moments created and published to feed

states.name: synced
states.description: Transaction imported but not promoted to feed

states.name: promoted
states.description: Transaction promoted to main feed due to high engagement

validation_rules: Engagement threshold is configurable per league (default: 5 interactions)
Promoted transactions appear in feed with transaction details
Promotion is one-way, transactions stay in feed once promoted
Duplicate moments not created if already promoted

error_states.name: promotion_failed
error_states.recovery: Retry promotion on next engagement event
error_states.user_message: Transaction details temporarily unavailable

rollback_procedures: If moment creation fails, flag for retry without losing engagement count
If promotion fails, transaction remains on transactions page
success_criteria: Feed moment created with transaction details
Transaction marked as promoted in database

states.name: visible
states.description: Content visible to all league members

states.name: pinned
states.description: Admin pinned content to top of feed

validation_rules: Only admins can pin, hide, or delete others' content
Authors can delete their own content
Pinned moments display at top of feed regardless of timestamp
Hidden content not visible to non-admins but preserved in database
Deleted content soft deleted to preserve thread structure

error_states.name: moderation_action_failed
error_states.recovery: Preserve current state, admin can retry
error_states.user_message: Moderation action failed. Please try again.

rollback_procedures: If moderation action fails, content remains in previous state
Moderation actions are logged for audit trail
Hidden content can be restored by admin
success_criteria: Moderation action logged with admin ID and timestamp

state_synchronization.real_time_updates: Supabase realtime subscription on moments table filtered by league_id
state_synchronization.conflict_resolution: Server state always wins, re-fetch on conflict detected

FeedComponent.state_persistence: React Query cache with 5-minute stale time, localStorage for sort preference
cleanup_procedures: Unsubscribe from Supabase realtime on component unmount
Clear infinite query on league context change

local_states.name: selected_week
local_states.description: Currently selected week for content editing

local_states.name: unsaved_changes
local_states.description: Whether there are unsaved draft changes

state_synchronization.real_time_updates: No real-time sync needed, draft is single-user state
state_synchronization.conflict_resolution: Last write wins, show warning if concurrent edit detected

CommissionerDeskComponent.state_persistence: React Query cache + localStorage for unsaved changes recovery, 30-second debounced autosave to database
cleanup_procedures: Trigger autosave on unmount if unsaved changes exist
Warn user if navigating away with unsaved changes
Clear validation errors on component unmount

local_states.name: chart_loading
local_states.description: Chart data loading and rendering state

local_states.name: hovered_week
local_states.description: Week user is hovering over for tooltip

local_states.name: visible_teams
local_states.description: Team IDs currently visible on chart (for filtering)

state_synchronization.real_time_updates: Not needed, rankings are published weekly

PowerRankingsChart.state_persistence: React Query cache with 5-minute stale time, selected season in sessionStorage
cleanup_procedures: Destroy chart instance on unmount to prevent memory leaks

local_states.name: picks
local_states.description: User's current picks by matchup ID

state_synchronization.real_time_updates: Lock status updates via polling every 60 seconds near lock times
state_synchronization.conflict_resolution: Server state wins if user edits on multiple devices, show conflict warning

PickemsForm.state_persistence: React Query cache + localStorage for unsaved picks recovery, immediate save to database on pick change
cleanup_procedures: Save any unsaved picks on unmount
Stop lock time polling on unmount

state_synchronization.real_time_updates: Poll for updates every 2 minutes during grading periods

LeaderboardDisplay.state_persistence: React Query cache with 2-minute stale time, filter preferences in sessionStorage
cleanup_procedures: Clear cache on league context change

state_synchronization.real_time_updates: Supabase realtime subscription on league_memberships table
state_synchronization.conflict_resolution: Server state wins, refresh on conflict

MembershipApprovalQueue.state_persistence: React Query cache with 30-second stale time
cleanup_procedures: Cancel in-flight approval requests on unmount

state_synchronization.real_time_updates: Poll for new transactions every 5 minutes during active season

TransactionList.state_persistence: React Query infinite cache with 5-minute stale time
cleanup_procedures: Clear infinite query on league change

loading_states.name: initial_app_load
loading_states.description: First page load, checking authentication and loading critical data
loading_states.fallback: If >10 seconds, show error message with retry option

loading_states.name: data_mutation
loading_states.description: Saving changes, creating content, submitting forms
loading_states.fallback: If >5 seconds, show 'Still working...' message with cancel option

loading_states.name: background_sync
loading_states.fallback: Silent failure, retry on next interval

error_states.name: network_error
error_states.user_message: You're offline. Some features may not work. We'll retry automatically when your connection is restored.
error_states.fallback_behavior: Show cached data if available, queue writes for retry

error_states.name: authentication_error
error_states.user_message: Your session has expired. Please log in again.
error_states.fallback_behavior: Redirect to login page, preserve attempted navigation for post-login redirect

error_states.name: authorization_error
error_states.user_message: You don't have permission to access this. Contact your league admin if you think this is an error.
error_states.fallback_behavior: Show error page with explanation and action button to request access

error_states.name: data_validation_error
error_states.user_message: Please correct the errors highlighted below and try again.
error_states.fallback_behavior: Preserve user input, show specific field errors, allow retry

error_states.name: not_found_error
error_states.user_message: We couldn't find what you're looking for. It may have been deleted or moved.
error_states.fallback_behavior: Show 404 page with suggestions and navigation options

error_states.name: server_error
error_states.user_message: Something went wrong on our end. We've been notified and are working on it. Please try again in a moment.
error_states.fallback_behavior: Show error page, log to monitoring service, retry after 30s

error_states.name: rate_limit_error
error_states.user_message: You're doing that too often. Please wait a moment and try again.
error_states.fallback_behavior: Disable action for countdown period, auto-retry after cooldown

connectivity_states.name: online
connectivity_states.description: Normal operation with full network connectivity

connectivity_states.name: offline
connectivity_states.user_feedback: Persistent banner: 'You're offline. Changes will be saved when you reconnect.'

connectivity_states.name: degraded
connectivity_states.user_feedback: Warning banner: 'Your connection is slow. Some features may be delayed.'

league_metadata.frequency: On league context change + every 24 hours

weekly_matchups.frequency: Every 5 minutes during game days, hourly otherwise

power_rankings.frequency: On publish + user navigation to rankings page

pickems_leaderboards.frequency: Every 2 minutes during grading periods, hourly otherwise

user_preferences.method: Write-through cache with immediate DB save

exceptions: Commissioner desk drafts use optimistic locking with version numbers
Pick'ems lock time strictly enforced, late submissions rejected
Concurrent comment/reaction creation allowed, no conflicts possible
conflict_resolution.user_notification: Show conflict warning if user edits stale data, offer to refresh and retry

cache_layers.name: browser_localStorage
cache_layers.ttl: 7 days for drafts, 30 days for preferences

invalidation_triggers.action: Invalidate specific query keys related to mutated entity
invalidation_triggers.example: After creating comment, invalidate moment query and feed query

invalidation_triggers.action: Update cache with new data or invalidate for refetch
invalidation_triggers.example: Supabase realtime insert triggers cache update

invalidation_triggers.action: Invalidate all queries for current page
invalidation_triggers.example: User pulls to refresh on mobile
Feed data older than 5 minutes triggers background refetch
Switching leagues clears previous league's cached data

read_access.limitations: Only previously loaded data available, no pagination or search

write_access.limitations: No immediate feedback for queued actions

offline_capability.rationale: FSHQ is primarily a web app requiring real-time data from external APIs. Full offline support adds complexity without significant value for the target use case of engaged fantasy sports users who are typically online when using the app.
offline_capability.future_consideration: Could add Service Worker for basic offline read access to recent feed in future if user demand exists

session_refresh.timing: Refresh 5 minutes before access token expires
session_refresh.failure_handling: Redirect to login if refresh fails

concurrent_sessions.sync_behavior: Session state synced across tabs via localStorage events
concurrent_sessions.logout_behavior: Logout in one tab logs out all tabs

idle_timeout.rationale: Users often leave fantasy apps open to check updates, idle timeout would cause frustration

session_recovery.on_page_reload: Attempt to restore session from refresh token
session_recovery.on_browser_crash: Session restored on restart if refresh token valid
session_recovery.on_token_theft: Supabase detects and invalidates compromised tokens
